model_decision: No universal winner. Original XGBoost performs better on overall accuracy and macro F1, while Class-Weighted XGBoost performs better on balanced accuracy and macro recall. Select a deployment candidate only after deciding the acceptable trade-off between missed attacks and false-positive alerts.
test_set_limitation: The test set was evaluated in Phase 8 and reused in Phase 10. These results are not an independent evaluation on a new untouched test set.
operational_limitation: Offline classification results do not prove real-time network detection or automatic threat prevention.
